delete.heading: This can't be undone
delete.body: Deleting your account permanently removes your profile, resume, searches, channel connections and application history. Any remaining credits are forfeited.
delete.fingerprintNote: We keep only a one-way hash of your email so that a new account with it doesn't get the sign-up bonus again.
delete.hint: Doesn't match your account email yet
delete.error: We couldn't delete your account. Try again, or contact support if this keeps happening.

deleted.heading: Your account has been deleted
deleted.body: All your data has been permanently removed.
deleted.fingerprintNote: A new account with the same email starts without the free sign-up credits.
